title: Ancient Scythian Elite Consumed Cannabis for Intoxicating Effects
description: Researchers recovered about 1,000 cannabis seeds from an eighth century BCE burial chamber in the Tunnug 1 princely tomb in Russia's Tyva Republic. Chemical traces of cannabinol and tetrahydrocannabinol were detected in preserved human hair, providing direct archaeological evidence that Scythian elite used cannabis for its intoxicating properties approximately 2,800 years ago.

title: Democrats plan to push clean energy to lower bills and challenge Trump’s fossil fuel agenda
description: Some Democrats are promising to push for more clean energy to help tackle rising energy costs when they take control of Congress in January. But President Donald Trump says he'll use his veto power aggressively. With new majorities in the House and Senate after last week’s midterms, Democrats can set an agenda boosting clean energy and addressing climate change. Democrats can begin investigations and hold hearings into climate policy rollbacks and elimination of green energy grants, potentially trying to undo some administration moves and restore renewable energy incentives.
